description.text: 自从菲兰雅女王国的崩溃将鹰身女妖民族分裂成100个族群后，远地萨拉哈德一直由锡亚杜娜女族长统治。她们从蛇脊山脉和波罗频伐多山脉的斜坡上飞起，突袭和猎食，在空荡的沙滩和参差的峭壁上投下不祥的阴影，在那里她们审视着自己的领地。在沙漠上空，锡亚杜娜鹰身女妖是无可争议的主人，马什恩希赫游牧民族和犍计阗牧羊人时刻警惕着她们的闪电袭击。这片贫瘠的土地是她们的，而且已经存在了几千年——如果锡亚杜娜鹰身女妖能为所欲为，那么在未来的一千年里，她们还会继续这样。
description.text_en: Since the collapse of the Firanyan Queendom fractured the harpy peoples into a hundred flocks, the Far Salahad has been ruled by the Siadúnan Matriarchs. From the slopes of the Serpentspine and Paravimvata they soar to raid and hunt, casting foreboding shadows on the empty sands and jagged crags from which they survey their domain. In the skies above the desert the Siadúnan harpies are undisputed masters, the Mašnsih nomads and Ghankedhen shepherds keeping constant vigilance against their lightning raids. This harsh land is theirs and has been for thousands of years - and if the Siadúnan harpies have it their way, it will be that way for a thousand more.

description.text:
曾经，远地萨拉哈德的鹰身女妖联合建立了一个自菲兰雅帝国被女猎手的弓箭分裂以来最强大的女族长国，但现已在历史的迷雾中消失了。远沙女族长国被她的人民称为锡亚丹伦，或「锡亚杜娜之国」，她是一个坚不可摧的堡垒，锡亚杜娜·焰爪的女儿们可以从那里统治。没有人能攻击它遥远的高山栖巢，或者侵占它广袤的不毛之地。数百年来，锡亚丹伦一直是东方的一个大国。

但贾赫和太阳精灵的到来如同飓风横扫了东方的沙漠，锡亚丹伦的女族长终于面对不仅足够在战场上打败她们，还能将她们赶回山间，围攻她们栖巢的无情敌人。在贾赫的猛攻下，鸟巢一个接一个地倒塌，无数的姐妹被自称的太阳神杀死。但自从凤皇推翻女王国已经过去很多年了，精灵们在几十年的内斗中变得虚弱和失去平衡。这是反击的时刻，夺回锡亚丹伦的遗产，向仍然占领远地萨拉哈德的精灵和给予他们援助的叛徒群体复仇。
description.text_en:
Once, the harpies of the Far Salahad were united in a great matriarchy, the mightiest since Firanya's own empire was sundered by the bow of the Huntsmistress in times lost to the fog of history. The Matriarchy of the Far Sands was called Siadanlén, or 'Siadúna's Country', by her people, and she was an impregnable fortress from which the Daughters of Siadúna Flaming-Talon could rule. None could assail her remote mountain roosts, or encroach upon the vastness of the badlands, and for hundreds of years Siadanlén was a major power in the East.

But the coming of Jaher and the Sun Elves blew like a fell wind across the Eastern Sands, and the Matriarchs of Siadanlén were finally faced with a foe implacable and skilled enough to not only defeat them on the field but to pursue them to their mountain fastnesses and lay terrible siege to her nests. Shattered by Jaher's onslaught, the roosts fell one by one, and countless sisters were killed by the self-proclaimed Sun God. But the years have been long since the Phoenix Emperor cast down the Matriarchy, and the elves are weak and off-balance from decades of infighting. This is the moment to strike, to reclaim the legacy of Siadanlén and revenge ourselves on the elves who still occupy the Far Salahad and the traitorous flocks who have given them succor.

description.text: 尽管锡亚杜娜鹰身女妖构成了威胁，但受罗祆和东洲的财富以及在布勒瓦尔市场上出售稀有丝绸和瓷器所带来的巨大利润的诱惑，商队仍是远地萨拉哈德地区的常客。然而，在阿兹卡苏尔和踏曷剌的安全港之间，没有躲避锡亚丹带翼强盗的庇护所，这些商队很容易成为目标。锡亚杜娜鹰身女妖多年来对那些不幸得到她们注意的商人进行掠夺，她们已经成为熟练和有组织的伏击者，她们从这些商队带走的黄金和俘虏使锡亚丹变得非常富有。
description.text_en: Despite the threat posed by the Siadúnan harpies, merchant caravans are a regular sight in the Far Salahad, lured by the riches of Rahen and Haless and the great profit they can make selling rare silks and porcelain goods in the markets of Bulwar. Between the safe havens of Azka Sur and Davharral, however, there is no shelter from the winged corsairs of Siádan, and these caravans make for easy targets. The Siadúnan harpies have become accomplished and organized ambushers from their many years of preying upon the merchants who are unfortunate enough to garner their attention, and the gold and captives they carry off from these caravans have made Siádan very rich indeed.

description.text: 当我们在鹰身女妖山脉的西方姐妹们认为豺狼人是害虫，是他们正当猎物的竞争对手时，锡亚丹的女族长们在历史上与布勒瓦尔的旧主人们有过共同的事业。远地萨拉哈德的女族长们发现，他们对布勒瓦尔人和太阳精灵的敌意远远超过了他们对彼此的敌意。多年来，对布勒瓦尔集中他们的努力而不是彼此对抗，使豺狼人和鹰身女妖勉强达成合作，最终1424年，佐迦·噬日者的豺狼人族群和女族长阿丝塔尔塔·锡亚杜诺的族群结成了两个物种之间的第一次正式联盟。
description.text_en: While our western sisters in Harpy Hills consider the gnolls as pests and competitors for their rightful prey, the Matriarchs of Siádan have historically made common cause with the old masters of Bulwar. Instead of conflict and rivalry, the matriarchs of the Far Salahad have found that the enmity for the Bulwari and the Sun Elves that they share with gnolls is far greater than their animosity towards each other. Over the years, the unspoken agreements to focus their efforts against the Bulwari instead of each other grew into grudging cooperation between gnoll and harpy, culminating in the first ever official alliance between the two species being forged between the great pack of Zokka Devourer-of-Suns and Matriarch Astárta Siadunó's flock in 1424 AA.

description.text: 锡亚丹的战争尖叫是一件可怕的事情，是一种刺耳的呼喊，刺穿耳朵，在每一块岩石和石头上回响，在那些不幸听到它的人的骨头里深深共鸣。虽然所有鹰身女妖都有能力发出可怕的叫声，但锡亚丹的鹰身女妖可以调用特殊的恐怖程度和恳求之音，聪明的人会放下武器和商品，而不是穿过平原去在可怕的雷霆般的地狱尖叫中奔向自己的坟墓。
description.text_en: The War Screech of Siádan is a terrible thing to behold, an ululating cry that pierces the ears and reverberates off every crag and stone, resonating deeply within the bones of those unfortunate enough to hear it. Though all harpies are capable of terrible cries, the warrior-flocks of Siádan invoke a special degree of terror and supplication in those who hear their call, and the wise have learned to lay down their arms and goods instead of going to an early grave when the terrible thunder of the Winged Hellscreamers rumbles across the plains.

description.text:
伊什塔拉·象牙羽毛是史上最伟大的女族长，她是一位无与伦比的战争领袖，既在战斗中野蛮，也在统治中睿智。灰元800年代初，在她的旗帜下，女族长国从西部的阿兹卡苏尔延伸到东部的摩楼他，锡亚丹伦的地狱尖叫者在布勒瓦尔和罗祆发动了突袭，没有受到老虎王国、豺狼王国和人类王国的对抗。然而，那些在她统治下的人发现象牙羽毛绝不是一个残暴的暴君——所有那些愿意定期支付制成品或专业知识的十分之一的人，在她的女族长国里都得到了公平的对待。

正是在象牙羽毛的时代，锡亚丹的最伟大的象征，伊什塔拉羽冠，一顶由黄金，宝石和女族长的羽毛制成华丽的王冠，被精心锻造出来。王冠像升起的太阳的辐射，由十几个俘虏矮人工匠锻造并回火。直到今天，这顶华丽的王冠仍然被用来为锡亚丹的女族长加冕。随着每一位新女王的登基，她都将自己的羽毛添加到王冠的羽毛中，这条不断加长的彩虹般的羽毛轨迹是对之前那些伟大的鹰身女妖的力量的可见证明。
description.text_en:
Ištara Ivoryfeather was the greatest matriarch to ever rule the Matriarchy of Siadanlén, an unsurpassed warleader who was as savage in battle as she was wise in her rule. Under her banner in the early 800s AA the Matriarchy stretched from Azka-Sur in the west to the Marutha in the East, and the Hellscreamers of Siadanlén launched raids throughout Bulwar and Rahen uncontested by the bickering kingdoms of tiger, gnoll, or man. Those who fell under her rule found the Ivoryfeather to be far from a sadistic tyrant, however - and all those who were willing to regularly pay their tithes of finished goods or specialty knowledge were dealt with fairly under her Matriarchy.

It was during the days of the Ivoryfeather that the greatest symbol of the Siadúnan Harpies was crafted - the Crest of Ištara, a magnificent crown of gold, gemstones, and the matriarch's own feathers, a diadem as radiant as the rising sun, crafted by a dozen captive dwarven artisans. This resplendent crown is still used to coronate the matriarchs of Siádan to this day. With each new matriarch adding her own feathers to the regal plumes with her ascension, the ever-lengthening rainbow trail of feathers is a visible testament to the power of the long and storied line of great harpy warmistresses who have come before.

description.text: 火药传入远地萨拉哈德地区使锡亚丹的鹰身女妖战斗和发动袭击的方式发生了重大变化。长时间以来，步弓一直是鹰身女妖小规模战斗的主要武器，在对付没有装甲的目标时总是有用，但在对付有盾牌或装甲精良的敌人时却不太可靠。火绳枪的穿透力使鹰身女妖能够克服早期火枪远程精准的问题，从而绕过他们的短弓的弱点。锡亚杜娜鹰身女妖总是军国主义的，并且愿意采用新的战术，她们在黄金大道沿线的突袭中捕获了火绳枪，并在16世纪后期开始改变他们的飞行队形，采用火器战术。锡亚丹年轻的鹰身女妖在很早就培训火药战争战术，开始熟悉在飞行或地面上使用这种武器，她们培养出的射击的准确性将有利于锡亚丹自由女族长国抵抗贾达尔军团沙漠凤凰的长期战争。向敌人的侧翼发射毁灭性的截击或投入刀爪接敌之前削弱敌人，锡亚丹的鹰身女妖证明了天空的女主人在给哈尔坎带来曙光的战争的新时代仍是强大的对手。
description.text_en: The introduction of gunpowder to the Far Salahad caused a major shift in the way that the harpies of Siádan fought and conducted their raids. The footbow, long a staple of harpy skirmishing tactics, was always useful against unarmored targets but had proven unreliable against shielded or well-armored foes. The penetrating power of the arquebus, meanwhile, allowed the harpies to circumvent the weakness of their shortbows if the problems of long-range accuracy on these early muskets could be overcome. Always militaristic and willing to adopt new tactics, the Siadúnan harpies experimented with arquebuses captured in their raids along the golden highway and began to modify their formation flying for firearm tactics in the later 16th century. Young harpies of Siádan would be trained in gunpowder warfare starting at a early age to familiarize themselves with using such weapons on the wing or standing, and the great accuracy cultivated by these youths would be a boon to the Free Matriarchs of Siádan in their long war of resistance against the Jaddari Desert Phoenixes. Delivering devastating volleys on the flanks of an enemy to demoralize or stagger a front line before plunging into the line with razor talons, the harpies of Siádan proved that the Mistresses of the Skies could and would remain formidable foes in the new age of powder warfare that was dawning on Halcann.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不愿承受强邻开局，或不想游玩强制迁离、杀降者等黑暗剧情的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先守山巢并择机复国，中期改名锡亚丹伦，后期整合跨区域帝国。
player_overview.overview: 锡亚丹是旧鹰身女妖王国的继承者，1444年仍受失国历史与强邻挤压。你要靠山巢与机动军队夺回祖地，再把快线、卫队和宫廷顾问制度铺向广大臣民，最终推动鹰身女妖帝国改革。复国故事并不纯粹光明：新帝国也可能以驱逐、屠杀与等级化统治维持秩序。前期战争压力和后期整合负担都很重。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢高压复国、鹰身女妖军队和复杂帝国政治的玩家。
signature_features: 围绕被凤凰帝国征服的锡亚丹伦旧国展开复国线。
山巢军事、风暴爪刃卫队和锡亚丹伦快线推动帝国扩展。
后宫顾问制度与臣民等级政治形成独特而尖锐的统治叙事。
player_overview.tagline: 从被凤凰帝国击碎的山巢夺回锡亚丹伦，重建鹰身女妖帝国。

reasons: 明确的失国与复国背景
鹰身女妖军事和山巢机制鲜明
帝国政治并非简单胜利叙事
warnings: 任务包含具体人格侵害

positive_indicators: 试图结束与臣民的无休止战争
快线和行政改革改善帝国联通
对金矮人提出修好意向
values.rationale: 复国、快线与部分行政改革有公共收益；当前剧情明确描绘驱逐豺狼人家庭、杀害降者及此前对金矮人的屠杀。扣分基于具体伤害而非征服或母系政体。
red_flags: 历史与任务文本承认对金矮人大规模屠杀
